articles.title: Transformer
articles.summary: In the 2017 Transformer, the encoder represents the input sequence. The decoder uses that representation and earlier outputs to generate the next symbol.

paragraphs.text: In the 2017 Transformer, the encoder represents the input sequence. The decoder uses that representation and earlier outputs to generate the next symbol.
Trace one output token in Figure 1. Where does the decoder receive information about the input sequence?

articles.title: Attention
articles.summary: In the paper’s definition of attention, each key is paired with a value. The match between a query and each key determines how much its value contributes to the weighted sum.

paragraphs.text: In the paper’s definition of attention, each key is paired with a value. The match between a query and each key determines how much its value contributes to the weighted sum.

Attention is a component of the 2017 Transformer. In encoder self-attention, each input position can draw on every position in the layer’s input. In encoder–decoder attention, decoder queries draw on keys and values from the encoder output.
Compare the two inputs to encoder–decoder attention in Figure 1. Which supplies the queries, and which supplies the keys and values?

articles.title: AionUi
articles.summary: AionUi Team Mode runs a group of agents around a shared task. A leader breaks down the request, assigns work to teammates, and gathers the results.

paragraphs.text: AionUi Team Mode runs a group of agents around a shared task. A leader breaks down the request, assigns work to teammates, and gathers the results.
Teammates work in a shared folder, exchange updates through an asynchronous mailbox, and use a common task board. Teammates can be added or removed while the team is running.

For a project where research, writing, and review keep exchanging updates, sketch which roles should stay on the team and what each should record on the shared task board. Compare that with a single review request sent to a Codeg worker.

articles.title: Codeg
articles.summary: With delegation enabled, a capable Codeg lead can hand a self-contained sub-task to another agent. Codeg starts a fresh worker session and returns its result for the lead to combine with its own work.

paragraphs.text: With delegation enabled, a capable Codeg lead can hand a self-contained sub-task to another agent. Codeg starts a fresh worker session and returns its result for the lead to combine with its own work.
The worker starts with the task description and its working folder. The lead supplies any conversation context needed to complete the handoff.
Delegation defaults to one level, from lead to worker. Increasing the configured depth allows a capable worker to delegate in turn.

For an implementation that needs an independent review, give the worker the goal, files or diff, constraints, and expected findings. Choose this scoped handoff when the lead can package the context and combine the answer. Compare it with keeping several roles coordinated on an AionUi team board.

articles.title: T3 Code
articles.summary: T3 Code provides a shared interface for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex running on a machine where they are configured. Desktop, web, and mobile clients can open the same threads, and a thread can continue with another model.

paragraphs.text: T3 Code provides a shared interface for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex running on a machine where they are configured. Desktop, web, and mobile clients can open the same threads, and a thread can continue with another model.

On desktop and web, the Agents view lets readers monitor delegated work and open a subagent's thread beside its parent. When an agent-created subagent needs approval or an answer, the request appears in the parent thread.

Pick a coding task with a focused review step. Decide whether to continue the main T3 Code thread with a different provider or delegate the review and inspect it beside the main thread. Compare the delegated option with Codeg's fresh worker session, and consider when AionUi's shared task board would help several roles stay coordinated.

articles.title: Antigravity Swarm
articles.summary: Antigravity Swarm is Google Antigravity's preview feature for coordinating a team of agents. With /swarm, the current conversation assigns work to named workers that run in parallel and coordinate on a shared board.

paragraphs.text: Antigravity Swarm is Google Antigravity's preview feature for coordinating a team of agents. With /swarm, the current conversation assigns work to named workers that run in parallel and coordinate on a shared board.

The coordinator typically adds a verifier that reviews each worker's changes, runs tests, and reports problems back to the worker. The board gives the team one place to share assignments, questions, and results.
Workers share the workspace and use the conversation's model by default. The coordinator can give workers separate repository working copies and assign a different model from the user's model picker.
Swarm coordinates work across agents. Google's separate Orchestrator feature can pair Gemini 4 Neon for planning with Gemini 4 Hydrogen for execution within one session.

In a test repository, use /swarm to assign date and currency tests to separate workers, then ask a verifier to run the suite. Open the shared board in the app or use /swarm board in the CLI to follow the handoffs and test results.

articles.title: Google Antigravity
articles.summary: Google introduced Antigravity alongside Gemini 3 as a development platform where agents can work across the editor, terminal, and browser.

paragraphs.text: Google introduced Antigravity alongside Gemini 3 as a development platform where agents can work across the editor, terminal, and browser.
Antigravity documents browser agents that can click and enter information on live pages. Its built-in browser agent and its local Chrome mode have different account, app, and setup requirements.
When an Antigravity built-in browser task reaches a sign-in or CAPTCHA, it pauses so the user can take over and then resume the task.

For a media workflow, ask the browser agent to open the relevant site, identify the generation controls, and stop before submitting anything. Check the page and the account yourself before deciding whether to run a sample.

articles.title: Google Flow
articles.summary: Google announced Flow in May 2025 as an AI filmmaking tool for creating and developing clips and scenes with Google DeepMind models such as Veo.

paragraphs.text: Google announced Flow in May 2025 as an AI filmmaking tool for creating and developing clips and scenes with Google DeepMind models such as Veo.
The Google Flow video interface lets users choose an output count for one prompt. Google also documents a Flow Agent that can make several variations of a clip in one request.

In a practice project, draft one shot of a paper boat drifting under a bridge. In Video settings, choose two outputs to compare the same shot in two versions. Check the displayed credit cost before generating.

articles.title: Tripo3D
articles.summary: Tripo Studio is Tripo's workspace for generating and refining 3D models. Its Image to 3D workflow turns a reference image into a model the user can inspect and export.

paragraphs.text: Tripo Studio is Tripo's workspace for generating and refining 3D models. Its Image to 3D workflow turns a reference image into a model the user can inspect and export.
Tripo Studio has a built-in batch image-to-3D option. It queues several images together, creates a separate 3D model for each image, and offers individual previews and a bulk download.

Try two reference images with permission to use them, such as a crate and a stool on plain backgrounds. In Tripo Studio choose Batch in the 3D workspace, review the inputs, then preview the mesh for each item before deciding what to export.

articles.title: Batch Generation
articles.summary: Batch generation can mean several outputs from one input or a group of separate jobs. Google Flow documents several video variants from one prompt, while Tripo Studio documents one 3D model per image in a submitted group.

paragraphs.text: Batch generation can mean several outputs from one input or a group of separate jobs. Google Flow documents several video variants from one prompt, while Tripo Studio documents one 3D model per image in a submitted group.

Before submitting a batch, record an ID for each input, the desired number of outputs, and how you will check success. Try a small sample first so a wrong setting does not turn into a whole collection of wrong results.

articles.title: Andrej Karpathy Skills
articles.summary: The Multica AI repository packages guidance derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations about coding with language models. Its four principles ask agents to clarify assumptions, keep implementation simple, limit edits to the task, and verify the result against concrete criteria.

paragraphs.text: The Multica AI repository packages guidance derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations about coding with language models. Its four principles ask agents to clarify assumptions, keep implementation simple, limit edits to the task, and verify the result against concrete criteria.
The skill turns a vague objective into a checkable result. Its bug-fixing example starts by writing a failing test for the reported behavior, then makes the change needed to pass it.

For a small bug fix, ask the coding agent to state its assumptions and identify the smallest change. Write down a failing case first, then check whether the final diff stays within scope and the test passes.

articles.title: Multica
articles.summary: Multica is a source-available, self-hostable workspace where a team can assign an issue to an AI coding agent. The agent runs on a connected machine, reports progress on the issue, and returns the result for human review.

paragraphs.text: Multica is a source-available, self-hostable workspace where a team can assign an issue to an AI coding agent. The agent runs on a connected machine, reports progress on the issue, and returns the result for human review.
Multica lets a workspace attach the same reusable skill to multiple agents. A skill contains a SKILL.md file and can include supporting scripts, templates, and reference files.

The Multica License adds conditions to Apache License 2.0. Its additional terms distinguish internal self-hosting from providing a hosted service to third parties or embedding Multica in a commercially distributed product.
Give an agent one documentation issue with a clear outcome. Follow its comments and execution log, then inspect the result on the same issue before approving it.

articles.title: PigBun Partner
articles.summary: PigBun Partner is a locally run AI collaboration tool. Its official documentation describes turning a goal from chat into a workstream that retains context, uses local tools, and asks the user for decisions or approval when needed.

paragraphs.text: PigBun Partner is a locally run AI collaboration tool. Its official documentation describes turning a goal from chat into a workstream that retains context, uses local tools, and asks the user for decisions or approval when needed.
The developer documents a browser workbench for tracking progress, blockers, and tool activity, with Claude Code and Codex as examples of local execution tools.
The developer describes PigBun Partner as alpha and says its core runtime is private. The public repository contains documentation, feedback, and release notes.
Sketch the same multi-day research task as a PigBun workstream and as a Multica issue. Compare where each tool surfaces progress and when the user would need to step in.

articles.title: Cindy
articles.summary: Cindy is a desktop and mobile AI agent client that provides a common interface for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Users can choose a supported agent and model combination, and the client can hand off or rebuild the engine context when switching agents.

paragraphs.text: Cindy is a desktop and mobile AI agent client that provides a common interface for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Users can choose a supported agent and model combination, and the client can hand off or rebuild the engine context when switching agents.
Cindy documents multi-agent teamwork within a task and cross-device access to the same session and project files on connected computers.
The Cindy repository contains the desktop and mobile clients and shared packages. Its source code is generally licensed under Apache 2.0, and the hosted backend lives in a separate repository.

Compare the same small documentation task in a Cindy session and a Multica issue. Keep the model, agent, machine, and input fixed where possible. Record time to first useful output, time to an accepted result, and time spent on setup or review.

articles.title: Batch Video and 3D Generation with Antigravity
articles.summary: Antigravity can prepare a web form through its browser agent. Google Flow offers multiple video outputs for one prompt, and Tripo Studio queues one 3D model per reference image. The services generate the outputs in their own interfaces.

paragraphs.text: Antigravity can prepare a web form through its browser agent. Google Flow offers multiple video outputs for one prompt, and Tripo Studio queues one 3D model per reference image. The services generate the outputs in their own interfaces.
Try the setup with a practice project and no submission. Can you show the exact controls, inputs and output count you would review before pressing Generate?

articles.title: Herdr
articles.summary: Herdr keeps terminal panes running when you disconnect from the session. It recognizes supported coding agents in those panes and shows which are working, waiting for input, or done.

paragraphs.text: Herdr keeps terminal panes running when you disconnect from the session. It recognizes supported coding agents in those panes and shows which are working, waiting for input, or done.
Run two small tasks in separate terminal panes. Detach and reconnect, then check which agent needs input without opening every pane.

articles.title: Magpie
articles.summary: Magpie gives supported coding clients a local gateway for model requests. You choose a provider and model for each client, and the gateway forwards requests to that provider.

paragraphs.text: Magpie gives supported coding clients a local gateway for model requests. You choose a provider and model for each client, and the gateway forwards requests to that provider.
Choose a model from a provider whose API you are authorized to use. Start a new conversation in your usual client and confirm in Magpie which provider received the request.

articles.title: Orca
articles.summary: Orca can launch coding agents in separate Git worktrees from the same repository. Each attempt has its own checkout, so you can review the diffs independently before choosing what to keep.

paragraphs.text: Orca can launch coding agents in separate Git worktrees from the same repository. Each attempt has its own checkout, so you can review the diffs independently before choosing what to keep.
In a practice repository, try two approaches to the same small improvement in separate Git worktrees. Compare the diffs and test results before choosing which change to keep.

articles.title: Wan 3.0
articles.summary: Alibaba's Wan 3.0 (wan3.0-video) generates video from a text description. Images, video clips and audio can guide what appears on screen and what the viewer hears.

paragraphs.text: Alibaba's Wan 3.0 (wan3.0-video) generates video from a text description. Images, video clips and audio can guide what appears on screen and what the viewer hears.
Alibaba Cloud documents clips of up to 30 seconds at 30 frames per second, with generated dialogue, music and sound effects. Creators can also edit or extend an existing clip.
Imagine filming a cup of coffee being poured. What would you describe in the prompt, and what would you supply as a reference image or sound?
